title: chore(polli-cli): bump version to 0.1.12
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Bumps `@pollinations/cli` from `0.1.11` to `0.1.12`.
- Updates the standalone CLI lockfile.
- Enables the npm release workflow to publish the merged OpenCode and Pi harness integrations.

Tests:
- `npm test` — 56 passed
- `npm run build`

gist.headline: Polli CLI gets new hands
gist.blurb: The Polli CLI is stepping out as 0.1.12, with its OpenCode and Pi harness integrations packed for npm. Tiny version number, noticeably more places to work.
gist.summary: Bumped @pollinations/cli from 0.1.11 to 0.1.12 so the npm release can publish the merged OpenCode and Pi harness integrations.
gist.impact: CLI users can install version 0.1.12 and use Pollinations through the newly published OpenCode and Pi integrations.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing a tiny tool belt, helps a cozy retro terminal connect two friendly plug-in harnesses labeled OpenCode and Pi; code-plants grow around the terminal to represent the newly published CLI integrations.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, a cute yellow bee with dark brown stripes, pink rectangular cheek blushes, light blue wings, and a tiny tool belt, plugging two small friendly harness modules labeled “OpenCode” and “Pi” into a glowing retro CLI terminal while code-plants bloom in lime green (#ecf874) pots. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
